name: lt-toast-dismiss-mid-enter
about: A toast dismissed by its close button half way through its entrance.

steps.js: (() => { const l=[...document.querySelectorAll('li[data-slot=toast]')]; const t=l[l.length-1]; const b=t && (t.querySelector('[data-slot=toast-close]') || t.querySelector('button[aria-label]') || t.querySelector('button')); if (b) b.click(); })()
